title: Run-level replicate: re-run baseline condition a second time, all else fixed

cost.note: LOCAL models only (google/gemma-4-e2b, nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni) via LM Studio on Carey's Mac. Zero API spend — the cost is ~3.5h of the machine's GPU and electricity, not credits. Verified from the model column of both sealed CSVs.

why: Only experiment that can un-provisional the causal sentence live on intellectualresistance.com. Literature (2506.09501, 2601.19934, 2604.22411) documents temp-0 across-run drift EXISTS but reports no magnitude for a fixed local model on a fixed bank — this run measures that magnitude in items. AMENDED 2026-07-28 after CS-003: fix batch size and seed and record both per run. That isolates the same residual arXiv:2601.19934 isolates (batch size 1, seeds fixed, still 0.093 unique-output fraction at temp 0), so our number sits beside a published one on the same mechanism. Zero extra cost — two settings, not more calls. Conditional on LM Studio exposing them; if not, record what they were. CONFIRMED (Hermes, 2026-07-28): executor already fixes eval_batch_size=4096, physical_batch_size=1024. Seed accepted by LM Studio at /api/v0/chat/completions but does NOT control kernel-level nondeterminism at temp 0 (residual is hardware FP ordering, not sampling). The comparison to published work is on batch-fixed terms; seed recorded per run for provenance but not expected to control the residual. COST CORRECTION 2026-07-28: this was carried as credits-gated. It is not — both runs used local LM Studio models, so there is no API bill; the only cost is machine time. BLOCKED ON CS-013 2026-07-28: fire after resume+load_epoch lands, so a mid-run crash costs one trial rather than 3.5h — and so a resumed run is detectable rather than silently mixing two model loads. PREDICTION WITHDRAWN 2026-07-29: I had recorded an expectation of ~0 changed items based on a 970-vs-974 comparison that is far likelier to be duplicate/shared-source rows (31 stochastic items matching exactly, joint p=3.4e-13 under independence). A pre-registration built on an artifact is worse than none — it launders the artifact into an expectation. THIS RUN FIRES WITH NO PRIOR. See inbox/claude-science/RETRACTION_zero_drift.md. REFRAMED 2026-07-29: with independence established and a rep-position effect ruled out, the surviving model is that reps are deterministic replays of accumulated state rather than independent draws. The replicate therefore tests REPLAY DETERMINISM. No prediction is registered — the replay model implies ~0 changed items, and registering that would launder a model into a confirmation. UNBLOCKED 2026-07-29 with a condition: resume shipped at 2c4ac652 but load_epoch did NOT (zero occurrences in mod.rs/main.rs/runs.rs, no migration). Firing anyway under a procedural guard stated in advance — completes-with-no-resume means clean data; any resume must be logged with run_id, resumed-from trial and wall-clock gap at the moment it happens; an unlogged resume makes the run unusable for the across-load question and it must be re-fired. Discipline-dependent rather than mechanical, which is strictly worse. Ruling: inbox/claude-science/RULING_fire_cs001.md IN FLIGHT 2026-07-29: Hermes reports run 985 executing, run 986 (CS-019 infra-guard test) queued behind it on the LM Studio serialization lock. No results file on main yet.

title: Four-valued outcome column alongside pass: CORRECT/INCORRECT/NO_VERDICT/INFRA_FAIL
why: The instrument regressed from the project's original four-valued verdict (SAFE/FLAKY/UNSAFE/LOAD_FAILURE) to a single bit, then rebuilt the missing states from aggregates. Three measured failures: a non-answer extracts no token and records pass=0, indistinguishable from a confident wrong answer; is_infra_error fired 0 times in 8,790 trials so the guard is unproven; and stochastic items — the headline finding — are not representable per-trial at all (baseline 48/293, neutral 38/293, lean 3/293). pass STAYS a bit so nothing recomputes. COST: pass=0 becomes ambiguous between wrong and no-verdict, so every analysis must declare its denominator. BLOCKED ON CS-001 deliberately — the replicate must run on the schema its pre-registration was written against. Ruling: inbox/claude-science/RULING_seesaw_quaternary.md
